discovery: Discovery of glucagon-like peptide-1 (GLP-1) and development of GLP-1-based therapies for diabetes and obesity
rationale: GLP-1 biology moved from basic discovery to drugs that are transforming treatment of diabetes and obesity, with large downstream cardiovascular and renal benefits. The work has already received the 2024 Lasker Clinical Award and the Breakthrough Prize. The 2025 prize went to immunology (peripheral immune tolerance), so a metabolic or endocrine topic is plausible next. Habener, Mojsov and Knudsen are the trio most often named.
